messages.subject: troubleshoot: root cause found (ruff not installed), status partial
messages.body: Report status is partial (Tier 2, confidence 0.50): I ran /sc:troubleshoot to completion and wrote .dev/p0-live/troubleshoot/REPORT.md; partial only because the evidence validator dropped one citation for a wrong line locator, which is re-cited. Root cause: ruff is declared only in the optional dev extra of pyproject.toml and plain uv run never installs extras, so in this fresh worktree the test's uv run ruff subprocess exits 2 with 'Failed to spawn: ruff'; supplying ruff 0.15.20 via uv run --with makes all 3 tests pass, the sibling test_claude_process_adapter.py ruff tests fail the same way, CI is unaffected because it installs .[dev]. Left for the coordinator: run make install in this worktree and re-run both test files (the outstanding positive witness), then plan the two-file test-guard change through /sc:workflow; no repo files were changed and nothing was committed.
